title: Every animation tracked with its preview and its source, the heavy ones on the share
summary: Every animation file the installation has been given is tracked in collection/ with its preview GIF and its readme beside it, except the heavy ones, the groups of the 8 long videos and every other file over 50,000,000 bytes, which move to collection/long/ and stay on the share, whose collection holds every file, ignored through .gitignore, with only their GIFs and readmes tracked; the seed also makes collection/README.md a tracked file, adds --beside to the converter's thumbnail subcommand, documents env and env.template, which name the share's collection for agents and the emulator's one-line commands, and corrects the pages and the decision, the repository being public.
